title: Poppies in Casein
content: Poppies, painted in casein, will be one of six paintings I’ll have in a botanical art show and sale.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)It’s one of six paintings I'll have atStonecrop Gardensin Cold Spring, NY at a botanical art show opening Monday through October 30, 2023.
